description.value: The Helmut Huber Food Services Building is the culinary training hub on Camosun College's Interurban campus, housing multiple eateries open to the public as well as students. The building supports the college's culinary arts programs, meaning food is prepared by students under professional instruction. A touring cyclist heading through the Saanich Peninsula would find a range of food options from quick snacks to fuller meals on this accessible campus.
